clauses.quote: Teachers shall have access to a lounge, exclusively for their use, in each School.
The SCAC shall develop policies and procedures for the use of the lounge.
clauses.notes: SCAC is a school-level advisory/administrative body.

clauses.quote: Where possible, DCPS shall provide free parking to Teachers at each School.
When the School co-located with a charter school, Teachers shall have priority in parking unless a preexisting Agreement provides otherwise.
The Parties agree to explore means of providing free parking for Teachers when such parking is insufficient at a School.
Money earned through school projects shall be kept in the Student Activity Fund (SAF) maintained at each school.
clauses.notes: Procedural fund-handling rule; implicit agent is administration.

clauses.quote: The Supervisor has the ultimate responsibility for all SAF monies received or disbursed within the school.
Projects shall be reviewed and approved by the Supervisor before being started.
Any funds raised under the conditions described in this Article shall be deposited in the SAF
clauses.subject_text: Any funds raised under the conditions described in this Article

clauses.quote: shall be used for school purposes only.
clauses.subject_text: Any funds raised under the conditions described in this Article
clauses.notes: Extracted as independent clause joined by 'and'.

clauses.quote: Funds raised by individual teachers or groups of teachers for specific uses (e.g., classroom grade level, departmental or recognized school club needs), shall be administered through the SAF as a separate “Activity”
clauses.subject_text: Funds raised by individual teachers or groups of teachers for specific uses (e.g., classroom grade level, departmental or recognized school club needs)

clauses.quote: except that those persons involved in the fund raising may agree to use all or part of the funds for other school purposes.
clauses.subject_text: those persons involved in the fund raising
clauses.notes: Worker discretion to reallocate raised funds.

clauses.quote: Funds raised for the benefit of all students in the School shall be deposited in the “General Fund Activity” within the SAF.
clauses.subject_text: Funds raised for the benefit of all students in the School

clauses.quote: Funds raised by the faculty as a whole for general school purposes shall be allocated under procedures developed by the Supervisor and the School Chapter Advisory Committee.
clauses.subject_text: Funds raised by the faculty as a whole for general school purposes

clauses.quote: Unused funds in specific accounts at the end of the school year shall be carried over in the account to the next year, unless otherwise specified in the Student Activity Fund Policy Manual.
clauses.subject_text: Unused funds in specific accounts at the end of the school year
